Delivery

Delivered and set exactly where you want it

Free delivery

Free shed delivery anywhere in Pennsylvania and 50 miles beyond state lines (excluding NY). Beyond this zone, delivery is $5 per mile.

Our drivers carry a unique piece of equipment called a Mule, a maneuverable, forklift-like device that gets your new building into tight spots a truck may not be able to reach. We can also build on site if access is limited.

6 helpful steps to design your structure

  1. Discuss access and site. Is access a problem? We'll build anywhere with our crews.
  2. Choose size. Tip: it's always better to go with a size larger than you think you may need now.
  3. Select options, from practical to decorative.
  4. Specify windows and doors.
  5. Pick a finish and color scheme.
  6. Choose a payment option: finance, cash, check, rent-to-own or credit card.

Need to build on site? We'll build anywhere with our crews; building on site adds 25% to the building and options ($1,000 minimum).

Site preparation: 3 options

A properly prepared site ensures the longevity of your structure. Make your choice at time of ordering.

Option 1 · Recommended

Professionally installed stone pad

Stone base: 4" limestone, slightly above ground level, #1 crusher run, tamped and laser leveled.
Timbered site: 4" limestone with treated timbers containing the edges and landscape fabric underneath, laser leveled.

Not available on rent-to-own.

Option 3

Lawn delivery, free

We place your structure at the exact spot you choose, directly on the lawn, for free. The 4x4 timbers that are part of the shed are pressure treated. Adjustments to the building's corners to align the doors will be needed over time, done by you with levers or jacks.
